name: Race flagships
notes: The ten race flagships (data/flagships.json, scripts/space/flagships.gd, docs/CONTENT.md section 25): their designs (ships/flagship_<race>.json, in a pack because they use the races' tech parts) and one unique tier 2-3 trophy part each (components.json), found only by beating that race's flagship: a variant of the race's own tech with the same pro and con, a step stronger. logs.json holds the log each flagship leaves.
